# Meta-clustering characterization

Move this to appendix

## Meta-clustering

```{r eval = FALSE}
library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(metasnf)
library(abcdutils)
library(ggplot2)


proc_path <- path_maker(here(paste0("data/abcd/results/processed")))
fig_path <- path_maker(here(paste0("data/abcd/results/figures")))
manuscript_path <- path_maker("~/documents/clustering-abcd-snf")

om_0_0_train <- read_csv(proc_path("2023_05_08_om_0_0_train.csv"))

min(om_0_0_train$min_p_val) # 3.41e-07
min(om_0_0_train$mean_p_val) # 0.005

top_oms <- top_om_per_cluster(om_0_0_train)

top_oms |> dplyr::select(c("significance", "row_id"))

write_csv(top_oms, proc_path("top_oms_0_0_train.csv", date = TRUE))

#om_scatter(top_oms,
#           save = fig_path("top_oms_0_0_train_scatter.png", date = TRUE))
om_scatter(top_oms)

mc_results_0_0_train <- meta_cluster(om_0_0_train)

write_csv(data.frame(mc_results_0_0_train),
          proc_path("mc_results_0_0_train.csv", date = TRUE))


mc_results_0_0_train <-
    as.matrix(read_csv(proc_path("2023_05_08_mc_results_0_0_train.csv")))

colnames(mc_results_0_0_train) <- as.character(seq_len(nrow(mc_results_0_0_train)))
rownames(mc_results_0_0_train) <- as.character(seq_len(nrow(mc_results_0_0_train)))

# ARIs between solutions
#mc_heatmap(mc_results_0_0_train,
#           save = fig_path("mc_results_0_0_train.png", date = TRUE))
mc_heatmap(mc_results_0_0_train)

mc_heatmap(mc_results_0_0_train,
           save = fig_path("mc_results_0_0_train.png", date = TRUE))

mc_heatmap(mc_results_0_0_train,
           save = manuscript_path("mc_results_0_0_train.png", date = TRUE))


## Trying to plot the input design matrix as a heatmap
mc_order_0_0_train <- get_pheatmap_order(mc_results_0_0_train)


## Design matrix
design_matrix <- read_csv(proc_path("2023_05_08_design_matrix.csv"))
    
design_matrix

dm_heatmap(
    design_matrix,
    fig_path("dm_original_0_0_train.png", date = TRUE)
)

dm_heatmap(
    design_matrix,
    manuscript_path("dm_original_0_0_train.png", date = TRUE)
)

dm_heatmap(design_matrix[mc_order_0_0_train, ],
           fig_path("dm_reordered_0_0_train.png", date = TRUE))

dm_heatmap(design_matrix[mc_order_0_0_train, ],
           manuscript_path("dm_reordered_0_0_train.png", date = TRUE))


mc_pvals_0_0_train <- p_val_select(om_0_0_train)

mc_pvals_reordered_0_0_train <- mc_pvals_0_0_train[mc_order_0_0_train, ]

# P-values
pvals_pheatmap(mc_pvals_reordered_0_0_train,
               save = fig_path("mc_pvals_0_0_train.png", date = TRUE))

pvals_pheatmap(mc_pvals_reordered_0_0_train,
               save = manuscript_path("mc_pvals_0_0_train.png", date = TRUE))
```
